Sam — short technical note to make the operational guarantees concrete. Quoting Irene above.

1) Data paths and isolation
- Tenant session payloads (customer interactions) are written to tenant-scoped object stores with ACLs enforced at the service mesh. These stores are tagged with tenant IDs and access-limited to the serving runtime.
- Model-improvement pipelines read only from a separate telemetry topic; the serving runtime publishes anonymized performance metrics to that topic (latency, token counts, error rates). No raw prompt/response payloads are published to improvement pipelines unless explicitly enabled for a customer.

2) Sampling and telemetry design
- Sampling is deterministic per-service and uses a tenant-scoped RNG seed to prevent accidental cross-tenant mixing.
- Default sampling rate for platform telemetry is 0.5% for full traces; we can set it to 0% for Mediclear during pilot.
- Any sampled payloads are passed through a configurable pre-ingest redaction step (regex + NL-based PII scrubber). We maintain a versioned policy file; we'll publish the exact policy used for the quarter as part of the compliance artifact.

3) Retention and exportability
- Session payload retention for tenant stores is configurable; for this pilot we will set retention to 30 days by default, with on-demand export/erasure via API.
- Exports for proof (e.g., KMS audit extracts, subprocessor snapshots) will be delivered via a secure SFTP or signed DocuSign bundle per your preference.

4) KMS and onshore routing
- For Mediclear we propose binding the pilot to an onshore KMS key (customer-managed if you wish). Audit logs for key usage are retained 12 months and can be included in the quarterly artifact.

5) Artifacts we can produce quarterly (suggested):
- subprocessor_inventory.csv snapshot;
- KMS key usage audit extract (signed);
- ops runbook excerpt showing sampling=0% configuration;
- a hashed sample of telemetry IDs (no payloads) that proves sampling controls were enforced.

If the legal team needs a stronger binding (signed attestation every quarter from our security lead) we can accommodate that for the pilot period; that would be a contractual addendum. Happy to jump on the call to walk through diagrams.
